to work out with labour. Pass., to be worn out, sore troubled: (WH, mg.), .†

G1268.as:
δια-νέμω [in LXX for חלק, De 29:26(25) * ;]
to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, .†

G1292.as:
διάστημα, -τος, τό (< διίστημι), [in LXX for רֶוַח, etc.;]
an interval, space: of time (Si, prol.24), .†

G1219.as:
** δημόσιος, -α, -ον (< δῆμος), [in LXX: II Mac 6:10, III Mac 2:27 4:7 * ;]
belonging to the people, public: ; dat. fem. used adverbially (cl.);
(a) at the public expense, by public consent;
(b) publicly: .†

G1282.as:
δια-πρίω [in LXX: I Ch 20:3 (שׂוּר) * ;]
to saw asunder. Pass., metaph. (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: ; seq. τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, .†

G1262.as:
δια-λύω [in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;]
to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: .†

G1237.as:
δια-δέχομαι [in LXX for מִשְׁנֶה (Deiss., BS, 115), פַּרְבָּר ;]
to receive through another, receive in turn: (RV, in their turn; v. Field, Notes, 116).†

G1296.as:
† δια-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ (< διατάσσω), [in LXX: II Es 4:11 (פַּרְשֶׁגֶן)* ;]
in late writers (Deiss., LAE, 86 ff.) for cl. διάταξις (wh., however, is found in LXX, Ps 118 (119):91, al.);
(a) disposition (cf. διάταξις for צְבָא; Sm., IV Ki 23:4, Je 8:2 19:13); εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων, AV, by the disposition of angels (Alf., in l., Field, Notes, 116; but v. infr.): ;
(b) ordinance (C. I. 3465): , , R, txt. (and v. mg.; Page and EGT, in l.; but also v. supr.).†

G1289.as:
δια-σπείρω [freq. in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;]
to scatter abroad, disperse: , .†

G1215.as:
δημηγορέω, -ῶ (< δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly), [in LXX: Pr 24:66 (30:31), IV Mac 5:15 * ;]
to deliver an oration: .†

G1218.as:
δῆμος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1. a district, country.
2. the common people, the people generally; esp. the people assembled: , .†
SYN.: λαός, the people at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opp. to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized multitude. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, a nation, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: Gentiles. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is freq. in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689).

G1200.as:
*† δεσμο-φύλαξ, -κος, ὁ (δεσμός, φύλαξ),
a prison-keeper, gaoler: , , (cf. ἀρχιδ-, Ge 39:21).†

G1246.as:
*† δια-κατ-ελέγχομαι
to confute completely: .†

G1216.as:
Δημήτριος, -ου, ὁ
Demetrius;
1. a silversmith, , .
2. A Christian disciple, .†

G1274.as:
** δι-ανύω [in LXX: II Mac 12:17 * ;]
1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: (EV).
2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.c. (Field, Notes, 134 f.).†

G1264.as:
δια-μάχομαι [in LXX for לחם ni., Da LXX 10:20; Si 8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;]
1. to struggle against.
2. In argument, to contend: .†

G1231.as:
δια-γινώσκω (v. previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. II Mac 9:15 ;]
1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly:
2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ’ ὑμᾶς, your case, (Cremer, 673).†

G1251.as:
δι-ακούω [in LXX: De 1:16 (שׁמע), Jb 9:33 (יָד שִׁית hi.)* ;]
to hear through, hear fully; technically, to hear judicially (as De, l.c.; of. Deiss., BS, 230): .†

G1240.as:
διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ (< διαδέχομαι), [in LXX: I Ch 18:17 (לְיַד), II Ch 26:11 (שַׂר) 28:7 (מִשְׁנֶה), Si 46:1 48:8, II Mac 4:29 14:26 * ;]
a successor: (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, v. Deiss., BS, 115).†

G1233.as:
** διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ (< διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Wi 3:18 * ;]
1. a distinguishing, also as medical term.
2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: (Cremer, 674).†

G1202.as:
δεσμώτης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for אסר, מַסְגֵּר ;]
a prisoner: , .†

G1277.as:
* δια-πλέω, -ῶ
to sail across: .†

G1206.as:
* δευτεραῖος, -α, -ον (< δεύτερος), adj. with adverbial sense;
on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, .†

G1293.as:
δια-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (< διαστέλλω), [in LXX for פְּדוּת: Ex 8:23(19), etc. ;]
1. a separation.
2. a distinction, difference: , .†

G1253.as:
διά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ (< διακρίνω) [in LXX for מִפְלָשׂ, Jb 37:16 * ;]
the act of judgment, discernment: , , .†

G1213.as:
δηλόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for ידע ;]
to make plain, declare: c. acc., , , ; c. dat. pers., ; c. dat. pers., seq. περί (pass.), ; seq. εἰς, .†
SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind.

G1243.as:
δι-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ (< διαιρέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
1. a distinction, diference.
2. a division, distribution: (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).†

G1214.as:
Δημᾶς, ὁ (perh. contracted from Δημήτριος),
Demas, a companion of St. Paul: , , .†

G1226.as:
* δια-βεβαιόομαι, -οῦμαι
to affirm confidently: ; seq. περί, (Cremer, 140).†

G1236.as:
δι-άγω [in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;]
1. to carry over.
2. Of time, to pass: βίον, ; absol., to live, seq. ἐν, .†

G1217.as:
** δημιουργός, -οῦ, ὑ (< δῆμος, ἔργον), [in LXX: II Mac 4:1 * ;]
1. one who works for the people.
2. Univ., an author, builder, maker; the maker of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), .†
SYN.: κτίστης, creator, τεχνίτης, craftsman, designer. In , τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution.

G1297.as:
† διά-ταγμα, -τος, τό (< διατάσσω), [in LXX: II Es 7:11 (נִשְׁתְּוָן), Es 3:13, Wi 11:7 * ;]
an edict, mandate: .†

G1238.as:
διάδημα, -τος, τό (< διαδέω, to bind round), [in LXX for כֶּתֶר (as Es 1:11), etc. ;]
the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: .†
SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but v. M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604).
